_comment: Real Monad mainnet logs (read-only eth_getTransactionReceipt, 2026-10-11) of another account using Kuru flip orders on market 0x52ce…74ce, blocks 110298080-111428427. They show partial fills: FlippedOrderCreated carries flippedId = parent after a partial fill, and later fills of the same parent emit FlipOrderUpdated(child, new total size). Market params read with getMarketParams() at latest block on 2026-10-11.
